what.title: What is it?
body: MySentinelCircle is a mutual safety net. You choose the people you trust, your Sentinels, and arrange them in circles around you: your 1st circle, the closest, then other circles (family, work, neighbors…).

If something worries you, or if someone worries about you, an alert can be raised. Your 1st circle is notified first. If it can't resolve the situation, it can ask your other circles for help, one step at a time.
It works in both directions: you can also be a Sentinel for the people who count on you.

how.title: How it works
items: Nobody becomes your Sentinel without accepting your invitation.
Your 1st circle has at least one Lead, who coordinates during an alert.
Alerts and replies go out by SMS too, so a Sentinel without the app can still help.

privacy.title: Privacy
items: Only you and your 1st circle see the full details of an alert. Another circle only sees the question it is asked.
Your Sentinels only see what they need to watch over you; you decide who can message you.

You can delete your account at any time from Settings. Your name, phone number, email, photo and circles are erased right away; messages and alert history stay readable by others, signed "Deleted account".

security.title: Security
items: Passwords and SMS codes are never stored as such, only in hashed form.
After 5 failed login attempts, the account is temporarily locked.
Sensitive actions (changing your email or phone, deleting your account) ask you to confirm your identity again.
The number of requests per minute is limited to slow down automated attacks.
